pool.text: The Kingdom of Singapura was founded on the island by Sang Nila Utama.
Portuguese raiders burned down the settlement, and the island faded into obscurity.
Stamford Raffles established Singapore as an entrepôt trading post of the British Empire.
Singapore came under direct British control as part of the Straits Settlements.
The national flower hybrid orchid was crossbred in a garden at Tanjong Pagar.
Muslim sepoys from British India staged the Singapore Mutiny.
Singapore was occupied by Japan during World War II.
Lloyd Valberg became the first Singaporean to participate in the Olympic Games.
The PAP has won large parliamentary majorities in every election since self-governance was granted.
Weightlifter Tan Howe Liang won a silver medal to become Singapore's first Olympic medalist.
Singapore became an independent sovereign country after expulsion from the federation.
The currency has been interchangeable with the Brunei dollar at par value.
The government introduced the vision of making Singapore a garden city.
The judicial system officially abolished trial by jury.
Britain pulled its military out of Singapore, leaving behind a token force.
Singapore Airlines was formed.
The Singapore Area Licensing Scheme became the world's first congestion pricing scheme.
Changi Airport was opened, replacing the international airport at Paya Lebar.
Nominated Members of Parliament were introduced to allow non-elected representatives.
The constitution was amended to provide for an elected president with veto powers.
